To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Dr. Lena Morris <lena.morris@fintechx.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Finalize backup roster and contingency roles for webinar Q&A

Hi all —

Two quick asks as we lock the run-of-show for next week’s "Serving LLMs at Scale" webinar:

1) Please confirm your backup/contingency role for the live Q&A and demo failure scenarios. Example roles: live Q&A moderator, overflow SME (steps in if guest gets pulled), AV switcher (slides/demo fallback), pre-recorded demo operator.

2) Can the guest speakers (Lena & Samir) confirm their availability for a short 30-min rehearsal slot next Tue (May 24) at 10:00 AM PDT? We’ll run the opening, demo handoff, and two failure simulations.

Attached: draft backup_roster_v1.xlsx (please mark your name & mobile). Run-of-show link below.

Notes: we need a clear fall-through if the demo cannot be completed — who plays an interim product explainer, and who hits the pre-recorded clip.

Thanks — I’ll compile and send the final assignments after confirmations.

—Olga

All — quick pass from the content side. My proposed assignments:

- Marissa Cole: Live Q&A moderator (triage incoming questions + tag for product vs. pricing).
- Karthik Iyer: Demo fallback owner (has the pre-recorded demo and will take over video share).
- Laura Bennett: AV switcher / stream operator (monitor stream health, flip to backup).
- Olga Petrov: Overall run lead and escalation to CS if a product question needs a customer ops answer.
- Ava Chen: Attendee comms and sync with registration.

Samir — can you be our overflow SME on content if Lena gets pulled? You’d be a two-slide backup and available for the second half.

I updated the roster and attached backup_roster_v2.xlsx with phone numbers and a short column for "fallback script ready? (yes/no)".

Happy to iterate — if one of you prefers a different role, call it out.

—Marissa

Thanks Marissa — agree with the roles. Couple of practical notes from the demo/infra side:

- I’ll bring the pre-recorded demo (MP4) and keep a slide-ready canned talk that bridges any gap if the live demo stalls. Please ensure the canned talk has the current token-cost example slide (slide 7) — I updated the copy in Drive.
- For handoffs: the script needs a single sentence to announce the handoff: "We’re going to toggle to a short recorded demo while we re-establish the live environment; Karthik will narrate." If Laura can be ready to switch sources on <=30s, we’re good.
- Q&A triage: Marissa, when you tag a question "demo-related", I’ll jump in and post a one-line follow-up that references the timestamp in the recording (if used).

Scheduling: confirmed for rehearsal Tue May 24 10:00–10:30 AM PDT (calendar invite here).

Team —

Thanks for the rehearsal — great run. Quick final assignments and contingency checklist (condensed):

Final roles: 
- Moderator / Q&A triage: Marissa Cole (tagging: "product", "pricing", "ops").
- Primary guest: Dr. Lena Morris.
- Overflow SME: Samir Gupta (standby slide deck: 2 slides).
- Demo fallback & pre-recorded operator: Karthik Iyer (has MP4 + local copy).
- AV switcher & recording lead: Laura Bennett (if stream fails, flip to recording and announce).
- Run lead & escalation: Olga Petrov.
- Registration & attendee comms: Ava Chen.

Contingency scripts (pinned in Drive):
- If demo fails: Laura flips to pre-recorded stream; Karthik narrates; Marissa opens Q&A.
- If guest connection is lost: Samir opens with the overflow slide, Lena continues via recorded audio if available.

Attached: run_of_show_v3.pdf (final). Please download and keep local copies of the two slides Lena requested (pricing + latency). I’ve also attached backup_roster_v2.xlsx to this email thread for mobile numbers.

On a logistics note: we will have live captions enabled and recording will be uploaded to the event page; Laura, please confirm captions are ON and storage retention is set to 90 days.

Thanks — I’ll do one last confirmation email 1 hour before the show.

—Olga
